user.title: Add a calibrated light
user.description: Light Match creates a calibrated twin of a light. The twin translates every command so that the same brightness and colour look the same on every calibrated lamp. Calibrate it in the Light Match panel in the sidebar.

data_description.name: Leave empty to use the source name plus "calibrated".

error.own_twin: This is already a Light Match light. Pick the real lamp.

abort.already_configured: This light already has a calibrated twin.

data_description.behaviour: How commands are translated for cells you have not calibrated yet.
data_description.reference_entity: The lamp the panel offers as the look to match. Usually the twin of your best lamp, set to "This lamp is the reference".
data_description.auto_floor: Use the known floor for the source's integration (WiZ: 26). Turn off to set the floor yourself.
data_description.brightness_floor: The lowest brightness the lamp really dims to; 0 for none. Used only when detection is off.
data_description.hide_source: Hide the real lamp from dashboards and voice assistants. It is shown again when you remove this light.

options.smart: Calibrated, smart defaults (scale colours below the brightness floor)
options.reference: This lamp is the reference (pass commands through)

not_a_twin.message: {entity_id} is not a Light Match light.

calibrate_cell.name: Calibrate cell
